MEMO_CONTRACT().notice: Arc Memo contract (same on both networks).

USDC().notice: Arc ERC-20 USDC address (same on testnet and mainnet).

accrueInterest(address).notice: Accrue interest for an asset. Callable by anyone (keeper, user).

addMarket(address,(address,address,addre.notice: Add a new asset market. Only OWNER. One call per asset.

borrowOnBehalfOf(address,uint256,address.notice: Borrow on behalf of `onBehalfOf`. Debt recorded to onBehalfOf;         funds sent to caller. Health factor checked against onBehalfOf.

claimPendingCollateral(address).notice: Claim collateral that was set aside during a blocklisted liquidation.

getHealthFactor(address).notice: Returns health factor in Ray. type(uint256).max when no debt.

liquidate(address,address,address,uint25.notice: Liquidate an undercollateralized position atomically.         Liquidator sends debtAmount of debtAsset and receives collateralAsset         plus the liquidation bonus.         Blocklist resilience: if collateral transfer fails, the amount is         recorded in pendingCollateral for the liquidator to claim later.

repay(address,uint256,bytes).notice: Repay `amount` of debt in `asset`.         `memo` is optional — if non-empty, attaches the reference to the tx         via Arc's Memo contract so it appears in on-chain history.

repayOnBehalfOf(address,uint256,address,.notice: Repay debt of `onBehalfOf`. Caller provides the funds.         Used by BatchRouter to repay a user's debt from pre-pulled tokens.

setMarketPaused(address,bool).notice: Pause or unpause a market. PAUSE_GUARDIAN.

setOracle(address,address).notice: Hot-swap oracle for an asset. RISK_ADMIN.

setRiskParams(address,uint16,uint16,uint.notice: Update risk parameters. Only RISK_ADMIN (via Timelock on mainnet).

supply(address,uint256).notice: Supply `amount` of `asset` to earn interest.         Mints sTokens to msg.sender. Permit2 approvals handled by the caller.

supplyOnBehalfOf(address,uint256,address.notice: Supply on behalf of `onBehalfOf`. Used by BatchRouter.         Caller has already pulled the tokens; sTokens minted to onBehalfOf.

withdraw(address,uint256).notice: Withdraw `amount` of `asset`. Burns sTokens. Pull-based: never pushes.

withdrawOnBehalfOf(address,uint256,addre.notice: Withdraw on behalf of `onBehalfOf`. Burns their sTokens; sends to caller.         Used by BatchRouter — caller must have sToken allowance from onBehalfOf.

withdrawReserves(address,address,uint256.notice: Withdraw protocol reserves to treasury. OWNER.
